content_sections.heading: ANH Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 23/SR/ANH/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download ANH notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS with PG Degree/ Diploma or any other equivalent qualification in the concerned specialty recognized by Medical Council of India; Registered with Delhi Medical Council (only qualification incorporated in DMC will be considered); Have not completed three years Senior Residency Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on date of interview) Age relaxation: PwD (Divyangjan) As per Govt. of India rules on submission of Handicapped Certificate from the competent authority Other conditions: Valid Delhi Medical Council registration, or DMC applied for on or before the date of interview Private practice of any kind is strictly prohibited; must not work simultaneously as SR in any other hospital May be required to perform duties in Accident & Emergency Department as per patient care needs Selected candidates must attend compulsory training on Bio-Medical Waste Management

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Ad-hoc appointment; initial appointment for 89/44 days Extendable for further 89/44 days with one day break, or till regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier Maximum tenure of Senior Resident is 03 years including previous tenure in any Govt. hospital/institute/organization 7 days prior notice for resignation, or deposit seven days salary in lieu No stake/claim over the post; services terminated when regular appointee joins

content_sections.heading: How Will ANH Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Under relaxed norms, a separate merit list is prepared for candidates who completed 3 years of SR Fresh candidates' list is exhausted first; relaxed-norm list is used only after that Appointments from the second list are for one year only and not renewable

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: All original certificates and testimonials Self-attested copies of all documents One passport size photograph Handicapped Certificate from competent authority (for PwD relaxation) Copy of Non-Creamy Layer certificate of current financial year (OBC)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ANH Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Report at Admin Office, 4th Floor, Ambedkar Nagar Hospital, Block-B, Sector-5, New Delhi-110062 on 26.11.2026 or 27.11.2026. Register between 09:30 AM and 11:00 AM on the date of interview; no candidate entertained after 11:00 AM. Bring all original certificates and testimonials. Submit self-attested copies of all documents with one passport size photograph.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Registration closes at 11:00 AM sharp No. of posts can change without prior notice, subject to actual availability at the time of interview Candidates already working elsewhere must submit relieving order before joining

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ANH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ANH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Senior Resident (Eye).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ANH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 26 November 2026 at 9:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Admin Office, 4th Floor, Ambedkar Nagar Hospital, Block-B, Sector-5, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on date of interview). Relaxation: PwD (Divyangjan) As per Govt. of India rules on submission of Handicapped Certificate from the competent authority.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Level-11 of Rs.67700 as per 7th CPC plus allowances as admissible.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS with PG Degree/ Diploma or any other equivalent qualification in the concerned specialty (Eye) recognized by Medical Council of India; registered with Delhi Medical Council; not completed three years Senior Residency.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Valid Delhi Medical Council registration, or DMC applied for on or before the date of interview. Private practice of any kind is strictly prohibited; must not work simultaneously as SR in any other hospital. May be required to perform duties in Accident & Emergency Department as per patient care needs. Selected candidates must attend compulsory training on Bio-Medical Waste Management.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Under relaxed norms, a separate merit list is prepared for candidates who completed 3 years of SR. Fresh candidates' list is exhausted first; relaxed-norm list is used only after that. Appointments from the second list are for one year only and not renewable.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ad-hoc appointment; initial appointment for 89/44 days. Extendable for further 89/44 days with one day break, or till regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. Maximum tenure of Senior Resident is 03 years including previous tenure in any Govt. hospital/institute/organization.
